annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology (Digital Strategy) / G7 Hiroshima AI Process
key_provisions_or_claims: Guiding principles for organizations developing advanced AI systems, including foundation models and generative AI
Builds on the OECD AI Principles as a living, non-exhaustive document
Applies to all AI actors across design, development, deployment and use
Accompanied by a voluntary Code of Conduct for AI developers agreed by G7 leaders
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page presenting the G7 Hiroshima Process International Guiding Principles for Organizations Developing Advanced AI Systems (30 Oct 2023). The voluntary, living principles build on the OECD AI Principles to promote safe, secure and trustworthy AI, focusing on foundation models and generative AI. The page shows only the summary, with the full text as a download.
